posts.trend: Gurugram woman spends over 50% salary on rent, shares why she wouldn't change it
posts.context: At thirty, the ambition to make a statement in the city degrades into a transaction of buying quietness at any cost.
posts.angle: The trajectory of adulthood in India is defined by the price of getting people to leave you alone.
slides: At twenty-two, you wanted to own the city.

At 22: "I will live in a penthouse."
At 26: "I want a flat close to the metro."
At 30: "I am paying ₹45,000 to hear myself think."

"Beta, adjust kar lo."

Your broker said the same thing.
posts.caption: Your flatmate knows exactly who this is, and so does the uncle on the third floor.
posts.rank_verdict: Slide one acts too much like an essay title or a table of contents, clearing its throat rather than hitting the reader with an immediate joke.
